sections.name: Partner program hero
sections.description: The partner-program opener: centered display headline with one gradient-accented phrase, dual CTA (apply plus partner guide), and three quick program stats (margin share, client seats, certification time) with mono instrument labels above a hairline rule.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: substring of title rendered in the brand gradient; the section's one gradient element

props.name: stats
props.doc: three quick program numbers; label sets in mono caps, note in small sans

sections.name: Partner tiers
sections.description: The three-rung program ladder (Registered, Certified, Strategic) as benefit cards: check-glyph benefit lists, one highlighted tier carrying the orange border and primary CTA, and a mono requirement footnote under a dashed rule on every card.

props.name: tiers
props.type: Array<{name, badge?, summary, benefits, ctaLabel, requirement}>
props.doc: requirement is the mono entry-bar footnote, e.g. 'req :: 5 live clients · 4 certified operators'

props.name: highlightIndex
props.doc: index of the tier that gets the orange border, floating elevation and primary CTA

sections.name: Agency proof
sections.description: Agency social proof on the sunken band: a strip of fictional agency text wordmarks in mixed type treatments, one pull quote from an agency operator against an orange rule, and a per-client partner-console mini visual with mono spend rows and status badges.

props.name: marks
props.doc: text wordmarks only, always fictional; style is 'display' | 'tracked' | 'sans'

props.name: marksLabel
props.doc: mono caption under the wordmark strip declaring the roster fictional

props.name: clients
props.doc: console rows; tone is a Badge tone ('success' | 'warning' | …)

sections.name: Co-sell steps
sections.description: How partnering works, in four numbered steps (apply, certify, launch the first client, share the margin): number chips joined by a connector line, short body copy per step, a mono time estimate under each, and the final margin step tinted on the accent-soft chip.

props.name: steps
props.doc: time is the mono estimate, e.g. 't :: 2 weeks'
